## Design note

The four-door land yacht with a big V8: the getaway car of every 70s crime film. Two tonnes, a lazy three-speed and a limited-slip axle mean it lays two black lines off the line and keeps pulling to 160 km/h, but the soft springs, slow steering and period brakes make every corner a negotiation. Slower than the Ironside, heavier, cheaper, and it carries four.

## How this car breaks

Heavy mild-steel body on a long frame-like unibody with chrome steel bumpers: it barges through light traffic and shrugs off parking knocks. But there is no real crumple zone and the pillars are mild steel, so a hard frontal goes into the cabin (Simulation lethality is high). Leaf-spring hangers tear out in rear hits, and the period fuel tank behind the axle makes a hard rear-ender a fire risk, as on the Ironside.

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| roll | 992 | 0.80 | 790 |
| pitch | 5423 | 0.95 | 5150 |

## Engine

6.6 L OHV pushrod V8, 4-barrel carburettor, high-output calibration (net rating). Net (installed) output class for mid-70s 6.6 L big-sedan V8s in high-output tune (~26 kW/L, 175 kW at 4400 rpm, ~475 N·m at 2800); emissions-era cam and compression keep the top end short, per period net ratings and owner dynos.

Peak **176 kW @ 4100 rpm**, **475 N·m @ 2800 rpm**. Idle 600 / redline 4800 / limiter 5100 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.32 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 57 N·m. Power-to-weight 88 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

3-speed automatic with torque converter, clutch-type limited-slip live rear axle (period option). Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 60 N·m, power ramp 0.40, coast ramp 0.20. Torque converter: stall 2000 rpm, 2.1× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2600 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.50 × peak torque = 710 N·m. Shift time 0.40 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2.46 | 7.58 | 83 |
| 2 | 1.46 | 4.50 | 140 |
| 3 | 1.00 | 3.08 | 205 |

Final drive 3.08, reverse 2.20. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.348 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.23 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 525 kg | 1.15 Hz | 27400 N/m | 1750 N·s/m | 2620 N·s/m | 0.20 m |
| Rear | 388 kg | 1.25 Hz | 23900 N/m | 1400 N·s/m | 2100 N·s/m | 0.22 m |

Round 12b ride rule (A): the file carries the derived dampers × 1.2 bump / × 1.6 rebound (rebound ≈ 2 × bump), after any tunes below: **2100 / 4190 N·s/m F, 1680 / 3360 N·s/m R** (bump / rebound).

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 6.5°/g with 70% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.462 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 79554 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 35091 F / 30613 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **8000 F / 0 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 6.0°/g, front share 65%. Bump stops 120000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.2° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 2.5°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 65 bar.

- Front: 298 mm disc, pistons per side 76 mm → A = 45.4 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 124 mm, pad μ = 0.3: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.3·65 bar·45.4 cm²·0.124 m = **2194 N·m**
- Rear: 279 mm leading/trailing drum, wheel cylinder 23.8 mm → A = 4.45 cm², drum radius 140 mm, brake factor 1.8 (includes lining μ): T = BF·p·A·r = **726 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 2525 N·m/wheel (capacity 0.87×), rear needs 876 N·m/wheel (capacity 0.83×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 760 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity is below that (hardware-limited rear), so `bias_front` = **0.5**: both axles get full caliper torque → delivered 2190 N·m front / 730 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 2240 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 19.5:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 13.2 m → outer-front path radius 6.49 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.92 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.558 rad (32.0°)** (outer 28.2°, inner 36.7° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.80). Rack speed 1.0 rad/s.

- Steel hood: 159 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Chrome steel bumpers: 180 bumper beams pp_bumper → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Period fuel tank behind the rear axle under the trunk floor (fails at 0.08 m).
